analyst_view.overall: A Baltic meeting in Kaunas between Kauno Zalgiris, last of 36 with 0 points and a 1-11 goal record (0-4 at Brighton, 1-4 at home to Brann, 0-3 at Lugano, where they had no shot on target until the 82nd minute), and Riga FC, 19th-20th after three draws (3 scored, 3 conceded). Both domestic seasons are over: Zalgiris won the Lithuanian title again and Riga finished second in Latvia, so neither side has played a competitive game since early November. Riga coach Adrian Gula said after the 1-1 with Jablonec that his side was tired after 50 matches since March; the break should freshen them but may also bring some rust. No injuries beyond Riga's two long-term absentees (Galo, Varslavans, already counted) and no referee were reported, and news for this match was thin, so the view rests on form and context.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals and already cut Zalgiris for scoring only 3 in their last six. I lean slightly lower to about 2.5: both teams come in with about three weeks without a competitive game, which tends to make for a slower, less sharp match; it is a mild hunch, not hard news.

corners.text: The numbers expect 8.7 corners, 4.8 for Zalgiris at home, and already count their low recent corner count (4 in three). Nothing on tactics or line-ups points either way, so I stay at about 8.7.

cards.text: The numbers expect 4.0 cards and already trim Riga sharply (-11.5%) for only 2 cards in their last three games and lift Zalgiris slightly. The Baltic-derby billing could add some edge, but no referee is named yet and neither side has a discipline story, so I stay at about 4.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.9 shots and already count Riga's busy recent shooting and Zalgiris's low output (21 shots in three). Both sides should be at full strength with no domestic games to rest players for, so I stay at about 28.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 shots on target, already down for Zalgiris's 4 on target in their last three (they managed one at Lugano). I found no line-up or injury news that changes this, so I stay at about 8.4.
